steps.name: Open schedule UI
steps.do: In the itinerary panel, open the schedule-an-item / scheduling controls.
steps.expect: Schedule module is visible (type, search, time).

steps.name: Choose type
steps.do: Select animal (or matching type for an itinerary item).
steps.expect: Type filter applies to searchable items.

steps.name: Search item
steps.do: Search for an animal already on the itinerary.

steps.name: Only on my itinerary
steps.do: Enable **Only show items on my itinerary**.

steps.name: Pick time
steps.do: Choose a valid time within arrival/departure if set.

steps.name: Optional duration
steps.do: Set duration if the field is shown.

steps.name: Schedule succeeds
steps.expect: A scheduled pill appears on the Day Planner timeline.

steps.name: Unschedule via pill menu
steps.do: Open the pill menu and unschedule.
steps.expect: Pill removed; item remains on list unscheduled.

steps.name: Reschedule
steps.do: Schedule the same item again at a different time.
steps.expect: New pill appears at the new time.

steps.name: Remove if offered
steps.do: From pill/list menu, remove from itinerary if available.
steps.expect: Item leaves itinerary (or note if remove is list-only).

steps.name: List vs planner sync
steps.do: Compare list view and Day Planner.
steps.expect: Scheduled vs unscheduled state matches across views.
